## Packages

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(countrycode)
library(wbstats)
library(dplyr)
library(fixest)
library(plm)
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)
library(broom)
```

## Load data

```{r}
data_zhang   <- read_xlsx("Inflation targeting dataset_Zhang 2025 online version.xlsx", sheet = "Data")
data_romelli <- read_xlsx("CBIData_Romelli_2025.xlsx", sheet = "CBI data")

# Romania has a different ISO code in Zhang's data
data_zhang$ISO[data_zhang$ISO == "ROM"] <- "ROU"

# Zhang: keep only the fourth quarter of each year, compute the band width
data_zhang_b <- data_zhang %>%
  rename(iso3 = ISO) %>%
  mutate(quarter = (quarterid - 1) %% 4 + 1,
         year    = 1980 + (quarterid - 1) %/% 4) %>%
  filter(quarter == 4) %>%
  mutate(band_width = inflation_target_upper - inflation_target_lower) %>%
  select(iso3, year, ITTR_A_1yr, band_width)

# Romelli: keep only the CBIE index
data_romelli_b <- data_romelli %>%
  rename(iso3 = iso_a3) %>%
  select(iso3, year, cbie_index)
```

## Figure 1: data availability

```{r, fig.height = 6.1}
avail <- data_zhang %>%
  mutate(quarter_no = (quarterid - 1) %% 4 + 1) %>%
  filter(quarter_no == 4) %>%
  mutate(observed = !is.na(ITTR_A_1yr))

first_obs <- avail %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(first_year = suppressWarnings(min(year[observed])), .groups = "drop")

avail <- avail %>%
  left_join(first_obs, by = "country") %>%
  mutate(country = reorder(country, -first_year))

n_countries <- n_distinct(avail$country)

cutoffs <- tibble(year  = c(2004, 2009, 2014),
                  label = c("20 yrs", "15 yrs", "10 yrs"))

ggplot(avail, aes(year, country, fill = observed)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(data = cutoffs, aes(xintercept = year - 0.5),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = cutoffs,
            aes(x = year - 0.5, y = n_countries + 1.2, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "#F8766D", `TRUE` = "#00BFC4"),
                    labels = c(`FALSE` = "Missing", `TRUE` = "Observed"),
                    name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1990, 2020, 5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.6, 1.8))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Fig. 1 - Inflation Targeting CBs by Country and Duration") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("fig1_availability.svg", width = 7.2, height = 6.1)
```

## Build the study data set

```{r}
v_countries <- c("Australia", "Brazil", "Canada", "Chile", "Colombia",
                 "Czech Republic", "Ghana", "Iceland", "Indonesia", "Mexico",
                 "Moldova", "New Zealand", "Paraguay", "Peru", "Philippines",
                 "Poland", "Romania", "South Africa", "Thailand", "Türkiye", "Uruguay")
v_iso3 <- c("AUS", "BRA", "CAN", "CHL", "COL", "CZE", "GHA", "ISL", "IDN", "MEX",
            "MDA", "NZL", "PRY", "PER", "PHL", "POL", "ROU", "ZAF", "THA", "TUR", "URY")
v_years <- 1993:2023

# World Bank income groups (high income vs not high income)
v_inc <- wb_countries() %>%
  select(iso3 = iso3c, income_level) %>%
  mutate(h_inc_dummy = ifelse(income_level == "High income", "High income", "Not high income"))

# One row per country and year, then add the data
data_study <- data.frame(country = rep(v_countries, each = length(v_years)),
                         iso3    = rep(v_iso3,      each = length(v_years)),
                         year    = rep(v_years, times = length(v_iso3)))

data_study <- data_study %>%
  left_join(data_romelli_b, by = c("iso3", "year")) %>%
  left_join(data_zhang_b,   by = c("iso3", "year")) %>%
  arrange(iso3, year) %>%
  group_by(iso3) %>%
  mutate(cbie_index_l1 = lag(cbie_index)) %>%      # CBI lagged by one year
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(region = countrycode(iso3, "iso3c", "region")) %>%
  left_join(v_inc, by = "iso3")

# Tell plm which columns identify the panel (country and year)
data_p <- pdata.frame(data_study, index = c("iso3", "year"))
```

## Descriptive statistics

```{r}
# Full merged panel
summary(data_study[, c("ITTR_A_1yr", "cbie_index_l1", "band_width")])

# Estimation sample: only rows where all three variables are available
data_est <- na.omit(data_study[, c("iso3", "year", "ITTR_A_1yr", "cbie_index_l1", "band_width")])
nrow(data_est)
summary(data_est[, c("ITTR_A_1yr", "cbie_index_l1", "band_width")])
```

## How much variation in CBI is left for the FE model?

```{r}
# Share of the total variance of CBIE that is within countries
with(data_study,
     var(cbie_index - ave(cbie_index, iso3, FUN = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)), na.rm = TRUE) /
       var(cbie_index, na.rm = TRUE))

# Share left after removing both country and year effects
r <- resid(feols(cbie_index ~ 1 | iso3 + year, data = data_study))
var(r) / var(data_study$cbie_index, na.rm = TRUE)
```

ggplot(data_study) +

## Models

Both models have country and year effects (`effect = "twoways"`).

```{r}
m_re <- plm(ITTR_A_1yr ~ cbie_index_l1 + band_width, data = data_p,
            model = "random", effect = "twoways")
summary(m_re)

m_fe <- plm(ITTR_A_1yr ~ cbie_index_l1 + band_width, data = data_p,
            model = "within", effect = "twoways")
summary(m_fe)
```

## Hausman tests

Classical Hausman test:

```{r}
phtest(m_fe, m_re)
```

Robust Hausman test (Mundlak version). The idea: add each country's average of the
regressors to a normal regression with year dummies. If those averages matter
(jointly significant with clustered standard errors), the country effects are
correlated with the regressors, so RE is inconsistent and FE should be used.

```{r}
# Country averages of the regressors (in the estimation sample)
data_est <- data_est %>%
  group_by(iso3) %>%
  mutate(cbie_mean = mean(cbie_index_l1),
         band_mean = mean(band_width)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Regression with and without the country averages
m_mundlak  <- lm(ITTR_A_1yr ~ cbie_index_l1 + band_width + cbie_mean + band_mean + factor(year),
                 data = data_est)
m_no_means <- lm(ITTR_A_1yr ~ cbie_index_l1 + band_width + factor(year),
                 data = data_est)

# Joint test that the averages are zero, standard errors clustered by country
waldtest(m_mundlak, m_no_means,
         vcov = vcovCL(m_mundlak, cluster = ~ iso3), test = "Chisq")
```

## Main result: FE with cluster-robust standard errors

```{r}
G <- pdim(m_fe)$nT$n   # number of countries (clusters)

m_fe_robust <- coeftest(m_fe,
                        vcov = vcovHC(m_fe, method = "arellano", type = "sss", cluster = "group"),
                        df   = G - 1)
m_fe_robust
```

## Robustness: subsamples (Table 1)

Same model as above, run separately for each region (only regions with at least
three countries) and each income group. Each subsample uses its own number of
countries for the degrees of freedom.

```{r}
# Regions: drop North America (1 country) and Sub-Saharan Africa (2 countries)
data_regions <- subset(data_study, !region %in% c("North America", "Sub-Saharan Africa"))

m_fe_regions <- lapply(split(data_regions, data_regions$region), function(d) {
  m <- plm(ITTR_A_1yr ~ cbie_index_l1 + band_width, data = d,
           index = c("iso3", "year"), model = "within", effect = "twoways")
  G_sub <- pdim(m)$nT$n
  coeftest(m,
           vcov = vcovHC(m, method = "arellano", type = "sss", cluster = "group"),
           df   = G_sub - 1)
})
m_fe_regions

m_fe_inc <- lapply(split(data_study, data_study$h_inc_dummy), function(d) {
  m <- plm(ITTR_A_1yr ~ cbie_index_l1 + band_width, data = d,
           index = c("iso3", "year"), model = "within", effect = "twoways")
  G_sub <- pdim(m)$nT$n
  coeftest(m,
           vcov = vcovHC(m, method = "arellano", type = "sss", cluster = "group"),
           df   = G_sub - 1)
})
m_fe_inc
```

## Robustness: leave one country out (Figure 3)

```{r}
m_loo <- bind_rows(lapply(v_iso3, function(cc) {
  m <- plm(ITTR_A_1yr ~ cbie_index_l1 + band_width,
           data = data_study[data_study$iso3 != cc, ],
           index = c("iso3", "year"), model = "within", effect = "twoways")
  G_m <- pdim(m)$nT$n
  ct  <- coeftest(m,
                  vcov = vcovHC(m, method = "arellano", type = "sss", cluster = "group"),
                  df   = G_m - 1)
  tidy(ct) %>% mutate(dropped = cc)
}))

# Add the full-sample estimate for the red line
m_loo <- m_loo %>%
  left_join(tidy(m_fe_robust) %>% select(term, est_full = estimate), by = "term")

# CBIE coefficient for each dropped country, sorted
m_loo %>%
  filter(term == "cbie_index_l1") %>%
  arrange(estimate) %>%
  select(dropped, estimate, std.error, p.value) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

ggplot(m_loo, aes(x = estimate, y = reorder(dropped, estimate),
                  xmin = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
                  xmax = estimate + 1.96 * std.error)) +
  geom_pointrange(size = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = est_full), colour = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ term, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "Fig. 3 - Leave-one-out check visualised",
       x = "Estimate when country is dropped (95% CI, cluster-robust)",
       y = "Country dropped") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("leave_one_out_check.svg", width = 5.86, height = 3.7)
```

## Cover page map (not run by default)

Change `eval = FALSE` to `eval = TRUE` to make the map.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
world <- subset(world, continent != "Antarctica")
world$highlight <- world$iso_a3_eh %in% v_iso3

ggplot(world) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = highlight), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#d7301f", `FALSE` = "grey85"), guide = "none") +
  coord_sf(crs = "+proj=robin") +
  theme_void()

ggsave("cover_page_plot.svg", width = 5.86, height = 3.7)
```
